svg.title: Ἡ ὁδός· ἐκ Σάρδεων ἐπὶ τὸν Εὐφράτην
svg.desc: Map of Asia Minor and northern Syria drawn from Natural Earth coastline data (public domain): the route of Cyrus’s march as a dashed line with a dot at selected stopping places (approximate), from Sardis inland east and south-east to Tarsus in Cilicia, then along the coast of the gulf to Issus and Myriandus, and inland east across Syria to the Euphrates at Thapsacus. The Euphrates is drawn as a blue line from the north-east down past Thapsacus. Labels: Σάρδεις, Ταρσοί, Εὐφράτης, θάλαττα. Site positions and the river line are approximate.
